title: 分级 · 高中｜信息整合与观点组织 · 60 句
description: 比较依据、证据、让步条件、材料转述及校园议题；练习限定观点和组织论证。

items.zh: 选择选修课时，兴趣和时间安排都值得考虑。
items.en: Both interest and scheduling deserve consideration when choosing optional courses.
answers: Both interest and scheduling deserve consideration when choosing optional courses.
items.notes: both ... and ... 连接两个选择依据。

items.zh: 线上讲座便于回放，现场讲座则更方便即时提问。
items.en: Online lectures allow replay, whereas live sessions make immediate questions easier.
answers: Online lectures allow replay, whereas live sessions make immediate questions easier.
items.notes: whereas 对照不同功能，保持比较维度清晰。

items.zh: 借用设备可以降低初期费用，但未必适合每天使用。
items.en: Borrowing equipment reduces initial costs but may not suit daily use.
answers: Borrowing equipment reduces initial costs but may not suit daily use.
items.notes: initial：初期的；may not 限定适用场景。

items.zh: 看起来最热闹的社团，不一定最适合你的目标。
items.en: The club that appears busiest is not necessarily the best match for your goals.
answers: The club that appears busiest is not necessarily the best match for your goals.
The club that appears busiest isn't necessarily the best match for your goals.
items.notes: not necessarily：未必；best match：最合适的选择。

items.zh: 短篇作品适合课堂细读，长篇作品则能展示更完整的发展。
items.en: Short texts suit close classroom reading, while longer works show fuller development.
answers: Short texts suit close classroom reading, while longer works show fuller development.
items.notes: close reading：细读；while 对照学习用途。

items.zh: 比赛成绩相同，并不意味着两组用了相同的方法。
items.en: Equal competition scores do not imply identical methods in the two groups.
answers: Equal competition scores do not imply identical methods in the two groups.
Equal competition scores don't imply identical methods in the two groups.
items.notes: imply：意味着；equal 与 identical 分别描述结果和方法。

items.zh: 保留纸质笔记还是使用电子笔记，应取决于实际任务。
items.en: The choice between paper and digital notes should depend on the task at hand.
answers: The choice between paper and digital notes should depend on the task at hand.
items.notes: the choice between：两者之间的选择；at hand：当前的。

items.zh: 评价一次研学时，不应把行程长短当成收获多少。
items.en: The length of a study trip should not be mistaken for the amount learned.
answers: The length of a study trip should not be mistaken for the amount learned.
The length of a study trip shouldn't be mistaken for the amount learned.
items.notes: mistake A for B 的被动形式：把 A 误当成 B。

items.zh: 人数较少的讨论组可能更容易让每个人发言。
items.en: A smaller discussion group may make it easier for each member to speak.
answers: A smaller discussion group may make it easier for each member to speak.
items.notes: make it easier for ... to：使某人更容易做。

items.zh: 选项越多，越需要先弄清自己最重视什么。
items.en: The more options there are, the more important it is to clarify what matters most.
answers: The more options there are, the more important it is to clarify what matters most.
items.notes: the more ... the more ...：越……越……。

items.zh: 同学们喜欢这堂课，可能与教师的回应方式有关。
items.en: The class's popularity may be connected with the way the teacher responds.
answers: The class's popularity may be connected with the way the teacher responds.
items.notes: may be connected with 保留因果不确定性。

items.zh: 两件事同时发生，不足以说明其中一件造成了另一件。
items.en: Two events occurring together are not enough to show that one caused the other.
answers: Two events occurring together are not enough to show that one caused the other.
Two events occurring together aren't enough to show that one caused the other.
items.notes: occurring 修饰 events；区分同时发生与因果。

items.zh: 为了判断方法是否有效，我们还需要了解起点水平。
items.en: To judge whether the method worked, we also need to know the starting level.
answers: To judge whether the method worked, we also need to know the starting level.
items.notes: to judge 表目的；whether 引导判断内容。

items.zh: 这份问卷只包含自愿回答者，因此可能漏掉不感兴趣的学生。
items.en: The questionnaire includes only volunteers and may therefore miss uninterested students.
answers: The questionnaire includes only volunteers and may therefore miss uninterested students.
items.notes: therefore 连接样本来源与可能遗漏。

items.zh: 一篇优秀作品能够说明可能做到什么，却不能说明人人都能做到。
items.en: An excellent piece of work shows what is possible, not what everyone can achieve.
answers: An excellent piece of work shows what is possible, not what everyone can achieve.
items.notes: 两个 what 从句区分可能性与普遍性。

items.zh: 复习时间增加后成绩提高了，但我们还不能排除其他因素。
items.en: Marks improved after revision time increased, but other factors have not been ruled out.
answers: Marks improved after revision time increased, but other factors have not been ruled out.
Marks improved after revision time increased, but other factors haven't been ruled out.
items.notes: rule out：排除；after 不直接证明因果。

items.zh: 如果评价只问满意不满意，就可能解释不了学习困难在哪里。
items.en: An evaluation asking only about satisfaction may not reveal where learning difficulties lie.
answers: An evaluation asking only about satisfaction may not reveal where learning difficulties lie.
items.notes: asking 修饰 evaluation；where ... lie：问题在哪里。

items.zh: 得出结论之前，应该先看看反例是否被忽略了。
items.en: Before reaching a conclusion, we should check whether counterexamples have been overlooked.
answers: Before reaching a conclusion, we should check whether counterexamples have been overlooked.
items.notes: counterexample：反例；have been overlooked：被忽视。

items.zh: 没有发现差异，也可能是因为比较的时间太短。
items.en: A failure to find a difference may reflect a comparison period that was too short.
answers: A failure to find a difference may reflect a comparison period that was too short.
items.notes: may reflect 引出替代解释；不把未发现视为不存在。

items.zh: 这项观察为猜想提供了支持，却还不足以证实它。
items.en: The observation supports the idea without being sufficient to confirm it.
answers: The observation supports the idea without being sufficient to confirm it.
items.notes: support 与 confirm 区分证据强度。

items.zh: 虽然公开排名能显示差距，但它也可能使部分学生不愿尝试新任务。
items.en: Although public rankings reveal gaps, they may discourage some pupils from attempting unfamiliar tasks.
answers: Although public rankings reveal gaps, they may discourage some pupils from attempting unfamiliar tasks.
items.notes: discourage someone from doing：使某人不愿做。

items.zh: 允许自行安排时间有助于培养责任感，前提是学生能获得必要指导。
items.en: Independent scheduling can build responsibility, provided students receive the guidance they need.
answers: Independent scheduling can build responsibility, provided students receive the guidance they need.
items.notes: provided 引出前提；they need 修饰 guidance。

items.zh: 即使采用同样的教材，不同课堂的学习体验也可能不同。
items.en: Even with the same textbook, learning experiences may differ between classrooms.
answers: Even with the same textbook, learning experiences may differ between classrooms.
items.notes: even with：即使使用……；differ between：在……之间不同。

items.zh: 节省十分钟并不总值得，尤其是在理解因此受损时。
items.en: Saving ten minutes is not always worthwhile, especially if understanding suffers.
answers: Saving ten minutes is not always worthwhile, especially if understanding suffers.
Saving ten minutes isn't always worthwhile, especially if understanding suffers.
items.notes: not always：不总是；especially if 强调特定条件。

items.zh: 我支持学生参与制定规则，但并不认为每一条规则都应由投票决定。
items.en: I support student involvement in rule-making without believing that every rule should be decided by a vote.
answers: I support student involvement in rule-making without believing that every rule should be decided by a vote.
items.notes: without doing 限定支持的范围。

items.zh: 除非参与者知道自己为何被分组，否则活动可能显得随意。
items.en: Unless participants understand the reason for their grouping, the activity may seem arbitrary.
answers: Unless participants understand the reason for their grouping, the activity may seem arbitrary.
items.notes: unless：除非；arbitrary：随意的。

items.zh: 这项建议可以减少重复劳动，却不能替代必要的练习。
items.en: The suggestion may reduce repetitive work, yet it cannot replace necessary practice.
answers: The suggestion may reduce repetitive work, yet it cannot replace necessary practice.
The suggestion may reduce repetitive work, yet it can't replace necessary practice.
items.notes: yet 表转折；区分重复劳动与练习价值。

items.zh: 只要能说明理由，学生就应该可以修改自己的立场。
items.en: Students should be free to revise their position as long as they explain why.
answers: Students should be free to revise their position as long as they explain why.
items.notes: as long as：只要；revise a position：修改立场。

items.zh: 竞争未必损害合作，关键是奖励依据如何设计。
items.en: Competition need not harm cooperation; much depends on how rewards are designed.
answers: Competition need not harm cooperation; much depends on how rewards are designed.
Competition needn't harm cooperation; much depends on how rewards are designed.
items.notes: need not：未必；how 从句说明关键条件。

items.zh: 对一部分人有效的方法不必被否定，但也不该被要求人人使用。
items.en: A method that helps some people need not be rejected, but neither should it be required of everyone.
answers: A method that helps some people need not be rejected, but neither should it be required of everyone.
A method that helps some people needn't be rejected, but neither should it be required of everyone.
items.notes: neither should ... 倒装，补充另一不应采取的做法。

items.zh: 两位受访者都赞同改变时间表，但理由不同。
items.en: Both interviewees supported changing the timetable, though their reasons differed.
answers: Both interviewees supported changing the timetable, though their reasons differed.
items.notes: both 指两者；though 标出共识之内的差别。

items.zh: 第一段介绍背景，第二段解释作者为什么改变看法。
items.en: The first paragraph sets the scene, and the second explains the author's change of view.
answers: The first paragraph sets the scene, and the second explains the author's change of view.
items.notes: set the scene：交代背景。

items.zh: 作者并未否认问题存在，而是质疑所提出的解决办法。
items.en: The writer questions the proposed solution without denying that the problem exists.
answers: The writer questions the proposed solution without denying that the problem exists.
items.notes: question 作动词表示质疑；without denying 限定立场。

items.zh: 据讲座介绍，这个项目最初是由学生发起的。
items.en: According to the lecture, the project was originally initiated by students.
answers: According to the lecture, the project was originally initiated by students.
items.notes: according to 标明信息来源；be initiated by：由……发起。

items.zh: 两个例子看似不同，实际都说明了提前准备的作用。
items.en: The examples appear different but both illustrate the value of preparation.
answers: The examples appear different but both illustrate the value of preparation.
items.notes: appear：看似；illustrate：说明。

items.zh: 摘要应保留作者的主要理由，而不必重复每个细节。
items.en: A summary should retain the main reasons without repeating every detail.
answers: A summary should retain the main reasons without repeating every detail.
items.notes: retain：保留；without doing：无需重复某行为。

items.zh: 这句话可以理解为提醒，而不一定是反对。
items.en: The sentence can be read as a caution rather than necessarily an objection.
answers: The sentence can be read as a caution rather than necessarily an objection.
items.notes: be read as：被理解为；caution：提醒。

items.zh: 文章结尾的问题把讨论从个人选择转向了学校责任。
items.en: The closing question shifts the discussion from personal choice to school responsibility.
answers: The closing question shifts the discussion from personal choice to school responsibility.
items.notes: shift ... from ... to ...：将……从……转向……。

items.zh: 我引用这个例子是为了说明局限，而不是证明整个方案失败。
items.en: I use this example to illustrate a limitation, not to prove that the whole plan failed.
answers: I use this example to illustrate a limitation, not to prove that the whole plan failed.
items.notes: 两个目的不定式区分引用作用。

items.zh: 报告强调了共同点，同时承认两个群体的需要不同。
items.en: The report stresses common ground while acknowledging different needs in the two groups.
answers: The report stresses common ground while acknowledging different needs in the two groups.
items.notes: common ground：共同点；while 表同时兼顾。

items.zh: 若社团名额只按报名速度分配，较晚获得消息的学生可能吃亏。
items.en: Allocating club places solely by registration speed may disadvantage pupils who hear the news later.
answers: Allocating club places solely by registration speed may disadvantage pupils who hear the news later.
items.notes: allocate：分配；who 从句限定受影响者。

items.zh: 午休区需要照顾想聊天的人，也需要照顾想安静休息的人。
items.en: A lunch-break area needs to accommodate conversation as well as quiet rest.
answers: A lunch-break area needs to accommodate conversation as well as quiet rest.
items.notes: accommodate：兼顾；as well as 连接两类需要。

items.zh: 匿名意见箱能降低表达压力，但学校仍需说明如何回应。
items.en: An anonymous suggestion box can ease pressure to speak, but the school still needs a response procedure.
answers: An anonymous suggestion box can ease pressure to speak, but the school still needs a response procedure.
items.notes: response procedure：回应流程；让步后补充执行要求。

items.zh: 校刊如果只刊登获奖作品，就难以展示创作过程中的探索。
items.en: A school magazine limited to prize-winning work may fail to show creative exploration.
answers: A school magazine limited to prize-winning work may fail to show creative exploration.
items.notes: limited to 限定收录范围；fail to show：未能呈现。

items.zh: 让学生参与图书采购，有助于发现借阅记录没有反映的兴趣。
items.en: Involving pupils in book purchasing may reveal interests absent from borrowing records.
answers: Involving pupils in book purchasing may reveal interests absent from borrowing records.
items.notes: absent from：未体现于；involve ... in：让……参与。

items.zh: 一项活动是否有价值，不能只看最后有没有拿到证书。
items.en: The value of an activity cannot be judged solely by whether it ends with a certificate.
answers: The value of an activity cannot be judged solely by whether it ends with a certificate.
The value of an activity can't be judged solely by whether it ends with a certificate.
items.notes: by whether：依据是否；solely 限制单一评价标准。

items.zh: 参观结束后留下讨论时间，可能比再增加一个参观点更有用。
items.en: Time for discussion after a visit may be more useful than adding another stop.
answers: Time for discussion after a visit may be more useful than adding another stop.
items.notes: 比较两种时间分配方式，而不是单看数量。

items.zh: 自由选题能够提高投入程度，但过宽的题目需要教师帮助缩小。
items.en: Choosing a topic can increase engagement, though overly broad topics need a teacher's help to narrow them.
answers: Choosing a topic can increase engagement, though overly broad topics need a teacher's help to narrow them.
items.notes: narrow a topic：缩小题目范围；though 补充指导需要。

items.zh: 展示失败的实验可以帮助同学理解，结论并非一开始就明确。
items.en: Displaying unsuccessful experiments can show pupils that conclusions are not clear from the outset.
answers: Displaying unsuccessful experiments can show pupils that conclusions are not clear from the outset.
Displaying unsuccessful experiments can show pupils that conclusions aren't clear from the outset.
items.notes: from the outset：从一开始；that 从句说明教学作用。

items.zh: 如果值日安排只强调处罚，就可能忽略工具不足的问题。
items.en: A duty system focused only on penalties may overlook a shortage of cleaning equipment.
answers: A duty system focused only on penalties may overlook a shortage of cleaning equipment.
items.notes: focused on 修饰 system；overlook：忽略。

items.zh: 与其说手机必然影响学习，不如说它的影响取决于使用方式。
items.en: Rather than inevitably harming learning, phones have effects that depend on how they are used.
answers: Rather than inevitably harming learning, phones have effects that depend on how they are used.
items.notes: rather than 修正绝对判断；depend on how：取决于如何。

items.zh: 有些同学从独立学习中受益，这并不说明合作学习毫无价值。
items.en: Some pupils benefit from independent study without this making cooperative learning worthless.
answers: Some pupils benefit from independent study without this making cooperative learning worthless.
items.notes: without this making ...：这并不导致另一极端结论。

items.zh: 我们有理由担心负担增加，但没有理由断言所有新活动都多余。
items.en: Concern about a heavier workload is justified; dismissing every new activity is not.
answers: Concern about a heavier workload is justified; dismissing every new activity is not.
Concern about a heavier workload is justified; dismissing every new activity isn't.
items.notes: is justified：有理由；并列省略避免重复。

items.zh: 阅读速度快可能有帮助，却不等于理解一定深入。
items.en: Reading quickly may help, but speed does not guarantee depth of understanding.
answers: Reading quickly may help, but speed does not guarantee depth of understanding.
Reading quickly may help, but speed doesn't guarantee depth of understanding.
items.notes: guarantee：保证；区分速度与理解深度。

items.zh: 同一个建议在考试周和假期可能需要不同的应用方式。
items.en: The same advice may need to be applied differently during exam week and the holidays.
answers: The same advice may need to be applied differently during exam week and the holidays.
items.notes: be applied differently：以不同方式应用。

items.zh: 没有发言的学生可能正在思考，不能直接被判定为不投入。
items.en: A student who says nothing may be thinking and should not automatically be judged disengaged.
answers: A student who says nothing may be thinking and should not automatically be judged disengaged.
A student who says nothing may be thinking and shouldn't automatically be judged disengaged.
items.notes: be judged + 形容词：被判断为某状态。

items.zh: 讨论的目标不必是消除所有分歧，也可以是让分歧更清楚。
items.en: Discussion can clarify disagreements without necessarily eliminating them.
answers: Discussion can clarify disagreements without necessarily eliminating them.
items.notes: clarify 与 eliminate 区分讨论目标。

items.zh: 指出计划的问题，并不意味着否认提出者的努力。
items.en: Identifying a flaw in a plan does not deny the effort of its author.
answers: Identifying a flaw in a plan does not deny the effort of its author.
Identifying a flaw in a plan doesn't deny the effort of its author.
items.notes: flaw：缺陷；否定方案部分内容不等于否定个人。

items.zh: 一次改变没有立刻奏效，不代表原来的做法一定更好。
items.en: A change that fails to work immediately does not prove the previous approach was better.
answers: A change that fails to work immediately does not prove the previous approach was better.
A change that fails to work immediately doesn't prove the previous approach was better.
items.notes: immediately 限定时间；不从短期结果推出整体结论。

items.zh: 比起承诺适用于所有人，说明建议适用于谁更负责任。
items.en: Explaining whom advice suits is more responsible than promising it works for everyone.
answers: Explaining whom advice suits is more responsible than promising it works for everyone.
items.notes: 两个动名词短语作比较；whom advice suits：适合谁。
